hooks.prompt:
After editing elisp files, run syntax validation tests with: ./test/run-syntax-tests.sh

Note: The test script validates claude-multi-status.el specifically. This is intentional - it ensures the core module loads correctly. Tests failing for other files is expected and okay. Only report test failures if they indicate actual syntax errors (unbalanced parens, load failures).

hooks.description: Final syntax validation check before session ends
